# Project Guidelines

When editing or creating Jekyll markdown posts, refer to the [Jekyll Post Conventions Skill](.github/skills/jekyll-post-conventions/SKILL.md) for detailed formatting guidelines, placeholder patterns, and code block conventions.

## Quick Reference

- **Placeholders:** Use angle brackets (`<placeholder-name>`) for environment-specific values
- **Indentation:** 2 spaces in all scripts
- **Callouts:** Use `{: .prompt-info }`, `{: .prompt-tip }`, `{: .prompt-warning }`, or `{: .prompt-danger }` with markdownlint wrappers
- **Frontmatter:** Required at the top of every post with title, date, categories, tags, and description
